mentions.name: mw-injector
mentions.description: mw-injector is a work-in-progress tool that detects Java, Node, Python, or Golang services running on a host and automatically instruments them with OpenTelemetry APM. Unlike the otel-injector that inspired it, it automatically selects service names for each detected service, providing service-level segregation of telemetry.
mentions.source_excerpt: mw-injector[0], it's a WIP project. It detects what Java, Node, Python or Golang services are running on a host and instruments it with Opentelemetry APM. Inspired by Otel-injector[1] but it automatically selects service names for each service so you have service level segregation.
